endpoints.summary: Searches activities using the supplied filters and returns matching paginated activity summaries.

params.name: start
params.description: Zero-based offset of the first activity to return. Defaults to 0.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of activities to return. Defaults to 99.

params.name: favorite
params.description: Filter by favorite status: 1 returns favorites, 0 returns non-favorites, and -1 applies no favorite filter. Defaults to -1.

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: Sort direction: asc for ascending or desc for descending, case-insensitive. Defaults to desc.

params.name: excludeChildren
params.description: Whether to exclude child activities that have a parent activity, such as individual legs of a multisport activity. Defaults to true.

params.name: sortBy
params.description: Activity field to sort by, such as name, distance, or duration. Defaults to startLocal, the activity's local start date and time.

params.name: search
params.description: Text to search for in activity names and descriptions.

params.name: activityType
params.description: Parent activity type key to include, such as running or cycling. Must identify a parent type, not a subtype.

params.name: activitySubType
params.description: Activity subtype key to include. Must identify a child type and, if activityType is also provided, belong to that parent type. For example, use activitySubType=trail_running with activityType=running, or activitySubType=road_cycling with activityType=cycling.

params.name: eventType
params.description: Event classification key to include, such as race, training, recreation, fitness, specialEvent, or uncategorized.

params.name: minDistance
params.description: Inclusive minimum activity distance, in meters.

params.name: maxDistance
params.description: Inclusive maximum activity distance, in meters.

params.name: minDuration
params.description: Inclusive minimum activity timer duration, in seconds.

params.name: maxDuration
params.description: Inclusive maximum activity timer duration, in seconds.

params.name: minElevation
params.description: Inclusive minimum total elevation gain for the activity, in meters.

params.name: maxElevation
params.description: Inclusive maximum total elevation gain for the activity, in meters.

params.name: startDate
params.description: Inclusive earliest activity start date, based on the activity's local start time, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

params.name: endDate
params.description: Inclusive latest activity start date, based on the activity's local start time, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

params.name: upperLatitude
params.description: Northern latitude boundary of the bounding box for activity start locations, in decimal degrees. Provide all four latitude and longitude boundaries to apply this filter.

params.name: rightLongitude
params.description: Eastern longitude boundary of the bounding box for activity start locations, in decimal degrees. Provide all four latitude and longitude boundaries to apply this filter.

params.name: lowerLatitude
params.description: Southern latitude boundary of the bounding box for activity start locations, in decimal degrees. Provide all four latitude and longitude boundaries to apply this filter.

params.name: leftLongitude
params.description: Western longitude boundary of the bounding box for activity start locations, in decimal degrees. Provide all four latitude and longitude boundaries to apply this filter.

params.name: lowerMaxDepth
params.description: Inclusive lower bound on the dive activity's maximum depth, in centimeters.

params.name: upperMaxDepth
params.description: Inclusive upper bound on the dive activity's maximum depth, in centimeters.

params.name: decoDive
params.description: Filter by decompression dive status: true returns decompression dives and false returns activities marked as non-decompression dives. Omit to apply no decompression dive filter.

params.name: minElapsedDuration
params.description: Inclusive minimum total elapsed activity duration, including paused time, in seconds.

params.name: maxElapsedDuration
params.description: Inclusive maximum total elapsed activity duration, including paused time, in seconds.

params.name: minBottomTime
params.description: Inclusive minimum dive bottom time, in seconds.

params.name: maxBottomTime
params.description: Inclusive maximum dive bottom time, in seconds.

params.name: minAvgPower
params.description: Inclusive minimum average activity power, in watts.

params.name: excludedActivitySubType
params.description: Activity subtype keys to exclude. Repeat this query parameter to exclude multiple subtypes.

params.name: requiredField
params.description: Activity fields that must have a non-null value for an activity to be included. Repeat this query parameter to require multiple fields; all specified fields must be present.

params.name: calendarDate

params.name: fullHistoryScan
params.description: Whether to scan the full history to find the latest Fitness Age information. If false, only the last 28 days relative to the target calendar date will be considered.

Retrieves the user's daily nutrition summary for a specific calendar date. This includes the user's nutrition goals, nutrients consumed, and discrete events for the day. The response can optionally include meal-by-meal breakdowns of calories and other nutrients consumed by the user on the given date.

params.name: includeGoals
params.description: Goals are included by default unless requested with includeGoals=false

params.name: includeNutrition
params.description: Nutrition information is included by default unless requested with includeNutrition=false

params.name: includeMedia
params.description: Images is included by default unless requested with includeMedia=false

params.name: mealId
params.description: Id of the meal like id for Breakfast, Lunch, Snacks or Dinner

params.name: date
params.description: Date for which to retrieve the daily nutrition logs. Date must be in the YYYY-MM-DD format. The date is interpreted in the user's local timezone.
